decision_conditions: <p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:150%">The existing original metal profile fanlight is to be added back onto the new fan light within one month of its removal and retained as such thereafter.</span></span></span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:150%">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The works hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.</span></span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:150%">REASON:&nbsp; To comply with the provisions of Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990</span></span></span></p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0cm; text-align:justify" class="CM5"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:150%">If previously unknown evidence is discovered about historic character which would be affected by the works hereby granted, an appropriate record, together with recommendations for dealing with it in the context of the scheme, shall be approved in writing by the local planning authority before any of the permitted works are begun. The works shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.</span></span></span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:150%">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building. </span></span></span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:150%">All new external and internal works and finishes and works of making good to the retained fabric shall match the existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, colour, texture and profile, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any conditions(s) attached to this consent.</span></span></span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">REASON: To protect the special architectural or historic interest of the listed building.</span></span></p>
description:
Internal refurbishment to the ground floor circulation areas and library of The Park boarding house. Works include internal redecorations,
replacement of existing modern flooring, new internal lighting and replacement of 8 no. modern doors with fire doors.
